description: This file defines a React functional component named OnboardingModal. It provides a modal dialog for first-time users to select their preferred language, with options like English, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Hindi. The component manages its internal state for the selected language and interacts with context for global onboarding state and language setting.

methods.name: OnboardingModal()
methods.description: React functional component rendering a language selection modal for onboarding.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles the confirmation action when the user selects a language and clicks continue, setting the language and closing the modal.
